name: credits-bar
description: A live usage panel for Claude Code with a little pet: limit bars, pace warning, daily goal, context, tokens, cost per project, history and CSV export. English and Portuguese.

alertLow.title: First alert (%)
alertLow.description: Toast when a limit passes this percentage used.

alertHigh.title: Second alert (%)
alertHigh.description: Toast when a limit passes this percentage used.

compact.title: Compact panel
compact.description: auto: compact when the panel is short; always; never.

showHistory.title: Show 7-day history
showHistory.description: Daily spend and peak usage of the last 7 days.

showBreakdown.title: Show context breakdown
showBreakdown.description: What is filling the context window.

showTokens.title: Show session tokens
showTokens.description: Input, output and prompt-cache hit rate for the session.

showTurns.title: Show cost per reply
showTurns.description: Cost of the last reply and a mini chart of recent ones.

language.title: Language
language.description: Labels and messages: en or pt.

dailyGoal.title: Daily spend goal (USD)
dailyGoal.description: Shows a goal bar and alerts when today's spend reaches it. 0 turns it off.

sessionSummary.title: Session summary
sessionSummary.description: A toast with the total spent and limits used when the session ends.

showProjects.title: Show spend per project
showProjects.description: Top projects by spend over the last 7 days.

sound.title: Alert sound
sound.description: Play a sound with alerts. Works only where the platform has an audio player (macOS); plays nothing on Windows and Linux.

pet.title: Show the pet
pet.description: A little critter that naps, works, gets tired and celebrates, in the panel and next to the icon button.

petName.title: Pet name
petName.description: The name shown under the pet in the panel.
